# The instruction asks to add the LOG VALUE from column I to the corresponding items in column C.

# Column C is the 3rd column (index 2) - "Log Value" in the Requested table.
# Column I is the 9th column (index 8) - "Log Value" in the Basic Table.
# The mapping is based on Stock and Year.
# Requested Table: Stock (Col A), Year (Col B), Log Value (Col C)
# Basic Table: Year (Col G), Stock (Col H), Log Value (Col I)

# Let's extract the Basic Table data for mapping
# Basic Table starts from row 1 (index 0 in df if header is row 0)
# Columns G, H, I are indices 6, 7, 8
basic_table = df.iloc[1:, [6, 7, 8]].dropna(subset=[df.columns[8]])
basic_table.columns = ['Year', 'Stock', 'LogValue']
mapping = basic_table.set_index(['Stock', 'Year'])['LogValue'].to_dict()

# Now update the Requested Table (Column C)
# Requested Table: Stock (Col A), Year (Col B)
for i in range(1, len(df)):
    stock = df.iloc[i, 0]
    year = df.iloc[i, 1]
    if (stock, year) in mapping:
        df.iloc[i, 2] = mapping[(stock, year)]

# Save the modified dataframe to the output path
